verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no official React hosting or deploy platform, and therefore no public status page or incident history for one. The docs only say apps can be deployed to a CDN or static hosting service and point users to third-party frameworks such as Next.js. Hosting and deploy reliability is a fair question for a UI framework in an SSR/full-stack comparison, so the axis applies, and the missing evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
